series.title: زنجیرەی گەردەلوول (بەشی نوێ)
series.description: شاکاری گەورەی درامای کوردی لەسەر مێژووی هاوچەرخی کوردستان و قارەمانێتی گەلی کورد.

series.title: مەمی ئالان (درامای مێژوویی)
series.description: گەورەترین داستانی خۆشەویستی و مێژوویی نەتەوەی کورد بە دیمەنی سەرنجڕاکێش و کوالێتی 4K.

series.title: Muhtemel Ask - Possible Love (2026) (TR)
series.description: Defne, a woman in her thirties, is strong and composed, having built her career through hard work. One day, she realizes just how exhausted and isolated she has become; perhaps the time has come for love. However, two men who enter her life turn everything upside down. Caught between Kadir’s unsettling demeanor and Tolga’s games that shift the balance, Defne finds that nothing will ever be the same again.

series.title: Alti Ustu Istanbul - It's Just Istanbul (2026) (TR)
series.titleEn: EN - Alti Ustu Istanbul - It's Just Istanbul (2026) (TR)
series.description: For Emir and his friends—Hasan, Sadık, and Mert—who grew up in Ziyankâr, a working-class neighborhood on the outskirts of Istanbul, life feels like a game they’ve lost before it even began. Trapped between poverty, violence, and despair, these four young men see soccer as their only chance to change their fate. They try to break free from this darkness through their friendship and their dreams.

series.title: Doganin Kanunu - The Law of Nature (2026) (TR)
series.titleEn: EN - Doganin Kanunu - The Law of Nature (2026) (TR)
series.description: The story revolves around Yaman, who applies for a job at the “Karaman” holding company but gets rejected… and Doğa, the daughter of the company’s owner. Five years later, their paths cross again, and from that moment a series of bright, funny, and touching events begins in the spirit of comedy and romance.

series.title: Delikanli - The Gentleman (2026) (TR)
series.description: Yusuf, who grew up in the suburbs of Istanbul, is a young man who tries to keep his family afloat and does not bow to injustice. While he dreams of a modest life with his childhood sweetheart Hazan, fate drags him into the middle of the underworld, power games and class conflict. When he reappears years later with a completely different identity, nothing is the same anymore; The wounds of the past and the hidden secrets will force him to follow both his heart and his revenge.

series.title: Cirkin - Ugly (2026) (TR)
series.description: The series follows Meryem, who holds onto life with nothing but good intentions, as she reunites with her one true love, Kadir—now a man whose world has been shaped by power, wealth, and ambition.

series.title: Doğanın Kanunu (2026) (TR)
series.description: The story revolves around Yaman, who applies for a job at the “Karaman” holding company but gets rejected… and Doğa, the daughter of the company’s owner. Five years later, their paths cross again, and from that moment a series of bright, funny, and touching events begins in the spirit of comedy and romance.

series.title: Daha 17 - Torn Apart (2026) (TR)
series.description: After losing his family as a child, Aras comes to Bodrum searching for his missing brother. But his life changes when he clashes with the powerful Akkaya family and falls for Leyla, the sister of his greatest enemy. As buried secrets emerge, Aras discovers that finding his brother is only the beginning.

series.title: Yeralti - Underground (2026) (TR)
series.description: Haydar Ali after avenging his family’s murder, ends up in prison. There, he finds himself in the middle of one of Türkiye’s most dangerous underground cartels. However, the truly deadly confrontation begins three years later, when he regains his freedom and learns that the woman whom he has never been able to forget, is now the wife of the man closest to him.

series.title: Minerva Academy (2026) (IT)
series.description: At Minerva Military High School, teens navigate discipline, rivalry and family pressure as a young cadet searches for answers about his missing friend.

series.title: A Different World (2026) (US)
series.description: Deborah Wayne enters her freshman year at her parents' HBCU alma mater and finds their shadow difficult to escape. She sets out to build her own legacy – while having the time of her life – alongside a whole new generation of Hillman’s best and brightest.

series.title: Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story (2026) (US)
series.titleEn: NF - Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story (2026) (US)
series.description: Trapped in a cruel Victorian-era household, Lizzie Borden kills her parents in a gory ax murder that shocks the nation.

series.title: Salcedo, Leather, and Boogaloo (2026) (CO)
series.description: Martín Salcedo is rarely swept off his feet — until Verónica Pinilla and Quiebra Canto turn up the party, booze and danger.

series.title: BAKI-DOU: The Invincible Samurai (2026) (JP)
series.description: Baki and the strongest Underground Arena fighters face a threat of historical proportions: the resurrected Musashi Miyamoto, Japan's greatest samurai.

series.title: Mocro Maffia (2018) (NL)
series.description: Best friends Romano, Potlood and De Paus rise in the rank of the criminal world. Before they know it, they run Amsterdam's entire coke market. Because of jealousy, their relation becomes complicated and ends up hostile.

series.title: Man on Fire (2026) (US)
series.description: Haunted by his past and hunted by his enemies, a Special Forces veteran fights to keep a teenage girl alive on the deadly streets of Rio de Janeiro.

series.title: Taskaree: The Smuggler's Web (2026) (IN)
series.description: A dedicated customs officer and his team take on a notorious smuggler leading a powerful syndicate, but unexpected obstacles threaten their mission.

series.title: مسلسل حب أسود
series.description: أجبرت لانا على قول "أوافق" فيما لم يترك لفارس حتى حق الاعتراض. بعد سنوات، يعود ليطعن في زواج انتزع فيه الرضا بالإكراه، ليكتشف أن الحب لم يكن وحده ما سلب منه...

series.title: مسلسل أحلى نصيب
series.description: زوج مؤقت. ومأزق يبدو مقيما. وبينما يحاول راكان ونورة إبقاء تمثيليتهما متقدمة بخطوة على الألسن والأقاويل، يكتسب الترتيب الذي بدا مثاليًا ميلًا متزايدًا للخروج عن النص.

series.title: مسلسل سيدو وحورية
series.description: يقرر سيدو التكفل بحفيدته حورية بعد وفاة أمها المفاجئة. في فصلهما الجديد معا، يضطر كلاهما للاعتماد على بعضهما للتعافي من الفقد، ومن شبح يطل بظله القاتم من الماضي.

series.title: مسلسل طالع نازل الحب اللي كان
series.titleEn: AR - مسلسل طالع نازل الحب اللي كان
series.description: تدور الأحداث حول موسيقار، يعيش حياة زوجية تبدو مستقرة مع زوجته، سيدة الأعمال القوية مالكة شركة كبرى. ورغم اتفاقهما على عدم الإنجاب، تخفي الزوجة رغبة عميقة في تكوين أسرة. لكن حياتها تنقلب رأسًا على عقب عندما تكتشف خيانة زوجها وزواجه سرًا من امرأة أخرى، فتجد نفسها في مواجهة صدمة قاسية تدفعها إلى خوض صراع نفسي بين الألم واستعادة كرامتها، بينما تتصاعد الأحداث نحو مواجهة حاسمة قد تقودها إلى الانتقام.

series.title: برنامج قوة الحب
series.description: تجتمع مجموعة من النساء والرجال التنافسيين في برنامج The Power of Love للعثور على شريك أحلامهم. كل أسبوع، يفوز بعض المتسابقين بالجائزة الأسبوعية، بينما يودع آخرون أحلامهم في الحب والمنزل. لحظات عاطفية ومفاجآت وتحديات مثيرة تنتظركم في هذا الموسم المثير!"

series.title: القصة الكاملة دراما: ما لم يُحكَ عن بني مزار
series.titleEn: AR - القصة الكاملة دراما: ما لم يُحكَ عن بني مزار
series.description: في إطار درامي تشويقي يعتمد على أحداث واقعية. تتناول الأحداث مجموعة من قصص منفصلة، تكشف تفاصيل وأسرار قضايا شهيرة. ويتناول العمل حكايات بارزة مثل "لعبة جهنم" و"ما لم يُحكَ عن بني مزار" و"سفاح المرج" و"ريا وسكينة" برؤية جديدة.

series.title: مسلسل خمسين خمسين
series.description: تدور الأحداث حول (رانيا)، المحامية المتفانية التي تنقلب حياتها رأسًا على عقب بعد اختفاء زوجها فجأةً، لتتحول إلى امرأة قوية تسعى للانتقام واستعادة حياتها بطرقها الخاصة بالتعاون مع ابنها.

series.title: برنامج تحت الضغط
series.description: تضع نادية الزعبي المشاهير تحت الضغط... لقمة تلو الأخرى. وكلما اشتد تحدي الطعام، ازدادت الأسئلة جرأة. ومع انعدام سبل الهروب، لا يبقى أمام الضيف سوى خيارين: إما أن يقول الحقيقة... أو يتذوقها!
